text.text: Lances only. While charging, clears a 3x3 cross-section up to 3 blocks along the horizontal crosshair direction (unaffected by looking up or down), breaking at most 9 blocks per tick with hardness at most 5. Uses Tinkers harvest processing for drops and durability. Skips fluids, block entities and unbreakable blocks. Breaking slows movement by 15% to 60%; higher lance mining speed reduces the penalty.
